# Analysis

按固定数据依次计算均值、样本方差、标准差与均值标准误。

```{r}
values <- c(12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25, 26)
size <- length(values)
center <- mean(values)
deviations <- values - center
squares <- deviations ^ 2
sum_squares <- sum(squares)
sample_variance <- sum_squares / (size - 1)
sample_sd <- sqrt(sample_variance)
standard_error <- sample_sd / sqrt(size)
rounded_center <- round(center, 2)
print(rounded_center)
print(standard_error)
```

此处的标准误解释以观测独立同分布且方差有限为前提。
